metadata.title: SEF Kopilot
metadata.description: Deterministic validation, explanations and reviewable repairs of electronic invoices (SEF, EN 16931, Peppol).

home.title: SEF Kopilot
home.tagline: Deterministic validation, plain-language explanations and reviewable repairs of electronic invoices for SEF, EN 16931 and Peppol.

footer.notice: An independent open-source project. It is not a certified validator, and it is not affiliated with the Serbian Ministry of Finance or the SEF platform.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with your account's e-mail address and password.
signIn.chooseOrganization: You are a member of several organizations. Which one are you signing in to?

register.title: Register
register.description: The account comes with an organization of its own, which you own.

authErrors.wrongCredentials: The address or the password is wrong.
authErrors.notAMember: You are not a member of that organization.
authErrors.emailTaken: An account with this address exists already.
authErrors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
authErrors.unreachable: The API is not answering. Try again a little later.
authErrors.failed: That did not work. Try again.

signedInOnly.title: Sign in
signedInOnly.description: Invoices are kept for your organization, so you see them once you sign in.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.uploadDescription: The validator checks the invoice under the profile you choose, and keeps it with its report for your organization.
invoices.notLoaded: The invoices did not load. Try again a little later.
invoices.none: No invoices yet. Send the first one above.

upload.fileHint: An invoice or a credit note in XML, as you send it to SEF.

uploadErrors.signedOut: The session has expired. Sign in again.
uploadErrors.tooSlow: The invoice was not received in time. Try again.
uploadErrors.tooLarge: The invoice is too large: it has more bytes or elements than this server accepts.
uploadErrors.notValidated: The validator could not check the invoice in time, or could not apply the rules to it.
uploadErrors.tooMany: Too many checks. Try again in {seconds} s.
uploadErrors.validatorBusy: The validator is busy. Try again in {seconds} s.
uploadErrors.validatorAway: The validator is not available right now. Try again a little later.
uploadErrors.storageFull: The organization has filled its space for invoices. Delete some, then try again.
uploadErrors.unreachable: The API is not answering. Try again a little later.
uploadErrors.failed: The invoice was not kept. Try again.

report.title: Report
report.notFound: This invoice does not exist, or is not yours.
report.notLoaded: The report did not load. Try again a little later.
report.violations: {fatal, plural, =0 {No errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, =0 {no warnings} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
report.omitted: Violations the report does not show: {count}.
report.setAside: Findings of published rules that this profile does not apply: {count}.
report.layerFound: {count, plural, =0 {no violations} one {# violation} other {# violations}}

explanations.title: Explanations
explanations.intro: A language model can explain each rule: what it requires, why the invoice fails it and what to change, citing the regulations that apply on the invoice's issue date.
explanations.privacy: The model is sent each rule's message, which may quote a value of the invoice, and passages of the regulations; nothing is kept.
explanations.writing: The language model is writing the explanations. This may take up to half a minute…
explanations.written: Explained by the language model {model}, from the regulations as of {day}. Every citation is a passage the model was given.
explanations.unexplained: Not explained this time: {rules}. They will be once the rules above are fixed.
explanations.problem: This rule was not explained this time. Try again.

errors.tooMany: Too many requests to the language model. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.noModel: No language model is set up on this server, so explanations are not available.
errors.tooSlow: The explanations did not arrive in time. Try again.
errors.unreachable: The API does not answer. Try again a little later.
errors.failed: The explanations were not written. Try again a little later.

repair.title: Repair
repair.notFound: This repair does not exist, or the invoice is not yours.
repair.notLoaded: The repair did not load. Try again a little later.
repair.heading: Repair of {when}
repair.unchanged: These changes do not change the invoice.
repair.needsDecision: A change to an amount, VAT, a tax or company identifier, a date or the document's number is never applied by itself: a person decides on it.
repair.gap: Lines that do not change are left out here.
